'''Spanner''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were stationed in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|hangar]] with Sergeant [[Joker]]. The sergeant often told jokes to pass the time, which Spanner often did not understand. The two clones also served on the [[Iceberg Three Republic outpost]] during the [[Mission to Iceberg Three]].
